full_judgment: 21. It has already been mentioned that in issuing the impugned order, the licensing authority acted at the behest of a Minister having no business with marriage registration. There was no other consideration. This, is true that section 4 of the Act LII of 1974 gives the Government discretionary power to extend, curtail or otherwise to alter the limits of an area for which a Nikah Registrar has been licensed: But such power has legal limitation by restrictive principles of reasonableness and fair play, and in some cases by that of natural justice. The power is, therefore, not absolute.
